game.title: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

lede: Atlanta Falcons carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#21 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tampa Bay Buccaneers +1.0 with a fair total of 43.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tampa Bay Buccaneers pass offence vs Atlanta Falcons pass defence, which sits −0.140 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Atlanta Falcons and Tampa Bay Buccaneers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
